name: AnimState
doc: A state selecting a pose graph and its normalized phase clock.

fields.name: duration
fields.doc: Duration in clip ticks; zero infers the longest descendant clip.

fields.name: looping
fields.doc: Whether to wrap the phase clock and repeat notifies.

fields.name: syncGroup
fields.doc: Nonempty group preserves normalized phase on entry and throughout cross-fades.
